stepBody: See image. Only type what is in the blank, do not include what is provided. Do not use spaces unless absolutely necessary. Please use double quotes (" "), instead of single quotes (' '). If you are utilizing the table, please use the numbers in order.##figure3.gif##

figureAlts.figure3.gif: (a) Find the name of the pokemon with highest HP among type Water pokemon. A fill-in-the-blank code block is shown. The first line defines water_pokemon as pokemon with three blanks. The second line uses water_pokemon with four blanks and includes a column method with "Name" and an item method with 0.
